NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. slices.title: Sweeper delete mode and propagation
slices.summary: With SESSION_RETENTION_SWEEP=enforce the sweeper deletes what the dry run listed: per thread one transaction calling delete_thread_rows, then after commit letta-bridge memory propagation and sandbox-manager DeleteThreadWorkspace, in batches of 100 with a per-org daily cap (default 10 000) and a hold re-check before each batch. First task is a Data Plane inventory of chat-derived content, deleting only through the Data Plane deletion contract (gaps are listed, not claimed). No new migration or proto; must cover every thread_id table in the registered list (C-B9: goals, revisions).
slices.remaining: All of it: enforce path using delete_thread_rows, letta-bridge and sandbox-manager propagation, per-org daily cap, second hold check, Data Plane inventory first. Turning enforce on in an environment needs one reviewed dry-run week (owner), not a build decision.

slices.title: Elicitation in the governed loop: resume question, pause, answer the held call
slices.summary: mcp_gateway.rs sets ProxyMcpToolRequest.allow_elicitation from GovernedMcp and gains an McpElicitationService client and answer_elicitation. execute_mcp (runtime_loop/mod.rs:2315): on a pending form create a question (delivery resume, origin mcp_elicitation, origin_label server label, items from the form, expires = hold left, idempotency {run}:{step}:elicit:<n>) and return the WS14-S5 input-pause outcome. resume.rs: consume the answer, map it back, AnswerMcpElicitation accept; skip -> decline; expiry/cancel -> cancel; lost held call -> tool error mcp_elicitation_expired. agent.rs admission: allow only when MCP_DO_ELICITATION (literal true, default off) && depth 0 && not ZDR/waived && parkable && no space_id; counts against MAX_QUESTIONS_PER_RUN.
